name: Sporthotel Manni
beschreibung:
History

The business appears today as MANNI das Hotel, website manni.tirol. Booking pages carry the addition „ex. Mannis Sporthotel“. A founding year is not given on the hotel website retrieved. It describes the house as a Place-to-be in Mayrhofen for friends and families, in summer and in winter, and the wider MANNI world of hotel, shops and ski rental. The room page dates a concrete modernisation: since summer 2024, 8 Comfort Studios and 8 Classic Rooms have been equipped with new air-conditioning units and can be booked. An older chronicle beyond this renaming and the air-conditioning conversion is not on the pages retrieved.

Getting there

The contact page names the address Hauptstraße 439, 6290 Mayrhofen, telephone +43 5285 63301, email dashotel@mannis.at. It describes the location as in the middle of things, „gleich ums Eck“ from mountain railways, bars, shopping and leisure, without stating a bus stop, a station or a figure in minutes. Mayrhofen lies in the Zillertal. The page mentions the Hochgebirgs-Naturpark Zillertaler Alpen and four large ski areas, without listing them by name on this contact page. A parking rule is not on the pages retrieved.

Tips

The room page names up to 94 guests, categories from the single room to the suite, furnishings in Classic Style, largely with real-wood furniture and floors. Listed categories and starting prices per person: Single Room about 20 square metres from 125 euros, Classic Room about 22 square metres for 1 to 2 people from 112.50 euros, Comfort Room about 30 square metres for 1 to 2 people from 122.50 euros, Comfort Studio about 40 square metres for 1 to 3 people from 137.50 euros, MANNI Suite about 49 square metres for 1 to 3 people from 155 euros. The homepage advertises a summer holiday with a Sky-Pool and in winter over 500 piste kilometres as well as off-piste terrain. These piste kilometres are a statement by the hotel for the region, not a length at the house. MANNI Rental and shops exist at two locations; guests are to receive Special-Deals. Besides hotel rooms the page names apartments and a private chalet in the wider MANNI world. The older address info@sporthotel-manni.at no longer appears on the current contact page; there dashotel@mannis.at applies.

The contact page places Mayrhofen as follows: set between the three-thousand-metre peaks, heartbeat and showpiece of the Zillertal, with many summits, outdoor possibilities and alpine wildlife in four large ski areas and the Hochgebirgs-Naturpark Zillertaler Alpen. That is the hotel’s description of the location of the village, not a piste map of its own. The homepage separately sets summer, with mountaineering, hiking, climbing, biking and enjoyment, against winter, with over 500 piste kilometres and off-piste terrain. Telephone and email remain +43 5285 63301 and dashotel@mannis.at.
kurzbeschreibung: MANNI das Hotel, formerly Sporthotel Manni, at Hauptstraße 439 in Mayrhofen, with rooms up to the suite, rental stations and shops.
